text: The honest closing assessment of the Haverbrook Tickets build -- not a victory lap.
What's real: AWS and EKS infrastructure, CI/CD through GitHub Actions, and monitoring that found and fixed a genuine incident through its own investigation.
Three gaps are named plainly: no multi-region failover yet, the rest of the alert fleet hasn't been audited for the same blind spot, and the new canary check only covers the happy path.
A short, prioritized list for what comes next, led by auditing the rest of the alert fleet.
Series complete. Thank you for following this build end to end.
